name: it-service-desk
description: IT Service Desk and Network Asset Management System

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.db:generate: npm exec --prefix backend -- prisma generate --config backend/prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec --prefix backend -- prisma migrate dev --config backend/prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:deploy: npm exec --prefix backend -- prisma migrate deploy --config backend/prisma.config.ts
